mapper.select: SELECT interaction_id,thread_id,turn_id,tool_call_id,plan_revision_id,run_id,operation_key, questions_json,status,answers_json,revision,created_at_ms,updated_at_ms FROM ja_interaction_request WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, updated_at_ms DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT state FROM ja_conversation_turn WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}
SELECT thread_id,interaction_id,answers_json,page,is_collapsed,operation_key,revision,updated_at_ms FROM ja_interaction_draft WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND interaction_id=#{interactionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ja_interaction_draft(thread_id,interaction_id,answers_json,page,is_collapsed,operation_key,revision,updated_at_ms) VALUES(#{threadId},#{interactionId},#{answersJson},#{page},#{collapsed},#{operationKey},#{expectedDraftRevision}+1,#{occurredAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON CONFLICT(interaction_id) DO UPDATE SET answers_json=excluded.answers_json,page=excluded.page, is_collapsed=excluded.is_collapsed,operation_key=excluded.operation_key,revision=excluded.revision, updated_at_ms=excluded.updated_at_ms WHERE ja_interaction_draft.revision=#{expectedDraftRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(event_sequence) FROM ja_interaction_event WHERE thread_id=#{threadId}
